tools.description: Aareon provides enterprise property management software for social landlords, institutional owners and large managers across Europe, with a French organisation serving bailleurs sociaux: tenant and lease management, rent and charge accounting, allocation processes, maintenance and tenant self-service portals.
tools.real_estate_use: French social housing operates under rules no commercial system covers: regulated rents, the allocation commission, the surface and resource ceilings, the supplément de loyer. tools.name: Actelo
tools.positioning: Financing software for French IOBSP credit brokers, covering the calculation, document and invoicing side of a mortgage file.
tools.description: Actelo is a French SaaS platform for IOBSP credit brokers. It covers the financing side of a mortgage file end to end: eligibility and amortisation calculations, borrower insurance quoting, generation of the regulatory financing documents, a document management space, a borrower portal, invoicing of the parties involved and activity statistics. It is sold per user with a published monthly price and no commitment.
tools.real_estate_use: A mortgage broker takes in a buyer whose offer has just been accepted and has to turn a project into a bankable file within days. Actelo runs the calculation side: it works out which loan structures the project is eligible for, prices the borrower insurance, lists the supporting documents to collect, and produces the financing proposal and the regulatory paperwork. The borrower drops the documents in their own space instead of emailing them, and the broker follows the file stage by stage until the invoicing of the commission. Independent brokers and franchise networks use it as their whole back office rather than as an add-on to a CRM.

Invoicing of brokers, mandataires and partners, with activity statistics

tools.positioning: Energy management that ends in a works order — engineering-led rather than reporting-led.

tools.name: ARGUS Enterprise
tools.positioning: The cash-flow model the industry agreed to standardise on — a valuation is credible partly because it is an ARGUS file.

tools.name: BailFacile
tools.positioning: Rental management for French landlords who manage their own lots: compliant documents, automated rent receipts and indexation, e-signature, income and expense tracking.
tools.description: BailFacile is a French web application for private landlords managing their own rentals. It generates more than fifty pre-filled legal documents covering tenant arrival, tenancy, works, disputes and departure, and keeps them current with French rental law. It automates recurring obligations such as rent receipts and annual rent indexation, provides unlimited electronic signature and a smartphone condition report, sends registered letters from the account, and tracks one-off and recurring income and expenses to prepare the tax return. A tenant portal carries documents and exchanges. The editor states more than 100,000 landlords use it.
tools.real_estate_use: A French landlord who refuses a management mandate inherits the mandate's obligations anyway: a lease that satisfies the ALUR law, an entry and exit condition report that will hold up if the deposit is contested, a rent receipt every month, an indexation that has to be claimed within a year or is lost. BailFacile is what replaces the spreadsheet and the downloaded Word template for that person. The value sits in the calendar as much as the documents — the tool knows which action is due and issues it. Small letting agencies and SCI owners use it the same way, and the income and expense ledger is aimed squarely at the moment the landlord fills in the rental income section of their return.

tools.description: Zelok is a French rental platform with two connected halves. Tenants build one online application file, reusable across agencies, and search through an engine that scans listings published by professionals — the vendor cites more than 380,000 listings drawn from over 50 platforms and filtered against the applicant's criteria. Real estate professionals and the landlords they act for get the unpaid-rent side: a Garantie Totale insurance product that pays the rent every month on a fixed date, with compensation from the first euro within 24 hours, and cover for property damage and legal protection. The vendor states more than 37,000 professional partners and one tenant file created every twenty seconds.
tools.real_estate_use: A letting agent handling a portfolio for private landlords has two recurring problems: incomplete applications and owners who panic at the first missed payment. Zelok solves them in the same place — candidates arrive with a file already assembled and shared, and the agent subscribes the lease to the unpaid-rent guarantee so the owner receives the rent on a fixed date regardless of what the tenant does. For the applicant, the file is built once in a few minutes and reused with every agency contacted, and the search engine surfaces matching listings rather than requiring the applicant to monitor fifty portals. The agent also uses the platform as a way to win management mandates from owners who want the guarantee.

tools.name: Zillow
tools.positioning: The consumer entry point to US residential real estate, and therefore the largest paid lead channel for agents.
tools.description: Zillow is a consumer property portal carrying for-sale, for-rent and off-market inventory, the Zestimate automated valuation, and a set of professional products — Premier Agent advertising, Zillow Showcase listing enhancement, rental listing syndication and a mortgage marketplace.
tools.real_estate_use: For an agent, Zillow is rarely a listing tool and almost always an acquisition channel: buyer leads are sold by ZIP code share of voice through Premier Agent, and a seller conversation frequently starts from a Zestimate the owner has already seen. For a landlord, the rentals network is a primary source of applicants. Its data is also the reference point clients bring to a pricing meeting.

Zestimate automated valuation on most US homes
Premier Agent advertising sold by ZIP code
Zillow Showcase enhanced listing presentation
Rental listing syndication and application handling

tools.name: Zumper
tools.positioning: A rental marketplace built around applying from the phone, with instant-book style flows.
tools.description: Zumper is a rental listing marketplace covering apartments, houses and rooms, with in-platform applications, screening and rent payment. Its consumer positioning is speed: find, apply and be approved without a physical appointment.
tools.real_estate_use: Landlords and managers list here to reach renters who search on mobile and expect to apply immediately. For smaller landlords the platform doubles as the application and screening workflow, and its published national rent index is a common reference point in pricing discussions.
